Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic immunopeptidomics workflow involving MHC-I immunoprecipitation followed by LC-MS/MS. While the PRIDE title explicitly mentions DDA, the project also used SureQuant (PRM) for validation of specific peptides. The search was performed without a digestion enzyme (no-enzyme search), which is standard for immunopeptidomics.

scope: MHC-peptide complexes are immunoprecipitated (IP) from a population of cells of interest using an HLA-allele-specific antibody or pan-HLA antibody
Lysates were then added to protein A sepharose beads conjugated with 0.5 mg of pan-MHC-I antibody (clone W6/32), and incubated rotating at 4°C overnight (12-14 hours).
Peptide-MHC complexes were eluted by incubating beads in 10% acetic acid for 20 minutes at room temperature.
